conclusion: Frozen with two majors unresolved: the matrix claims a mutation-invariance the shallow-copy parser does not provide (P5-G1), and its forbidden-location sweep omits stages.<key>.params, letting a descriptor spelling slip through un-rejected against its own 'any nested location' rule (P5-G2).

findings.summary: matrix claims mutation-after-from_obj cannot change identity, but NodeSpec.from_obj shallow-copies (dict(value)), so the inner descriptor dict is shared and mutation changes the canonical hash.
findings.disposition: corrected in matrix v2: mutation/freeze protection moved out of Packet 5 scope; explicitly noted as broker-route (Packet 4 freeze_consumer_document/derive_consumer_port) + Packet 6 substitution.

findings.summary: location hole: StageSpec.params is an open dict that accepts a $captured_artifact descriptor with no detection, contradicting the matrix's ordinary-document refusal and ADR-0125 'any nested location'.
findings.disposition: corrected in matrix v2: forbidden_location now names StageSpec.params/inputs of the node-map stages section; test_stages.py added to new tests.

findings.summary: NodeSpec.from_obj has no document context, so it cannot express execution_backtest-only legality; unclear whether standalone NodeSpec accepts or refuses.
findings.disposition: corrected in matrix v2: node_level_role states NodeSpec only shape-validates; legality enforced by PipelineDocument.__post_init__.

findings.summary: purpose 'non-empty str' is stricter than trust.py equality (empty allowed); benign divergence undocumented.
findings.disposition: corrected in matrix v2: purpose value documented as intentionally stricter than broker route; no closed purpose set exists in ADR-0125.
